title: Surgical extraction of an impacted lower wisdom tooth, patient on Eliquis

transcript.speaker: DENTIST
transcript.text: Before we start, any changes to your medications?

transcript.speaker: PATIENT
transcript.text: I'm on Eliquis for atrial fibrillation. My cardiologist said it was okay to hold it yesterday.

transcript.speaker: DENTIST
transcript.text: Good, thanks. Number seventeen is partially impacted and the gum keeps getting infected around it.

transcript.speaker: DENTIST
transcript.text: Raising a flap, sectioning the tooth. Surgical extraction of seventeen complete.

transcript.speaker: DENTIST
transcript.text: Restart the Eliquis tomorrow morning, and come back in one week to remove the sutures.
